same_question_isolation_scope.interpretation: documented four-context allocation, not independently observed absence of all communication or training memory

validator_static_gaps.gap: validate_ledger.py checks total cost4 but does not require exactly one charged source_open per registered slot or validate cumulative charged_total.
validator_static_gaps.observed_effect: Independent review checked all32 packets: each registered position is opened and charged once. Fourteen packets have nonascending opening order, which is permitted by AF100; no current cost defect.

validator_static_gaps.gap: The validator checks S total<=4800 but does not recompute first-match-200/max1200 per slot, exact per-event character totals or source Git blob hashes.
validator_static_gaps.observed_effect: This independent review recalculated these for registered packet source files and observed no mismatch.

validator_static_gaps.gap: Assignment uniqueness and a false previous-exposure flag do not prove absence of actual cross-context access. Access log events lack reader identity; the wrapper is not OS isolation.
validator_static_gaps.observed_effect: Four distinct assigned readers per question and ordered declared previous packet/source sets are checked. Actual hidden access and model pretraining memory remain unobservable.

validator_static_gaps.gap: Validator citation membership uses all logged displays regardless of timing/status and does not require display before recorded_utc.
validator_static_gaps.observed_effect: This independent review restricted coverage to successful displays before each initial recorded_utc. Every current citation remained covered.

validator_static_gaps.gap: The validator summary only automatically excludes stable_adjacent_resolved=false, while protocol strict_exclusions also mention vacancies, leakage, excess accesses, ranking/excerpt failures and outside-packet necessary evidence.
validator_static_gaps.observed_effect: No other observed integrity violation in this snapshot; future FAIL/warnings must not be reported as valid comparable statistics without explicitly applying affected-pair exclusions.

validator_static_gaps.gap: audit_added citations validate source boundaries, not semantic entailment; availability-auditor changes can be mistaken for original cold-reader discovery if the layers are merged.
validator_static_gaps.observed_effect: All32 original rows have audit_added absent/false. Keep original reader hashes and revised availability judgments, deltas, UTC and audit access receipts separately.

separation_required.initial_reader_metric: Use only immutable evidence/readers/R*/judgments.jsonl; do not retroactively repair initial citations or completeness.
separation_required.availability_metric: Separate pre-outcome audit may locate additional sufficient intervals inside the same registered packet. Preserve changed before/after statuses, reasons, source/byte positions and UTC; seal before opening public outcomes.
separation_required.not_discovery: An auditor seeing both routes and all first-reader outputs has wider procedural knowledge. A later availability correction is not a fresh-reader discovery or user execution.

review_history.resolution: Opening order was stricter than the actual AF100 protocol; source-open permutations with each slot exactly once are valid. corpus-files.jsonl is deliberately stored as lossless .jsonl.gz as declared in SCOPE.md. These checks were corrected without changing original data.

observed_open_order_variation.reason: AF100 requires four positions and no more than four accesses, without a prescribed within-packet slot order. The assignment case order is preserved.
observed_open_order_variation.per_slot_first_access_count: one for every registered slot in all32 packets
